user.title: Novafos Water
user.description: Log in on the Novafos website, copy the `access_token` from the `token` request in the browser's developer tools (F12 → Network) and paste it here. Tokens are valid for one hour; the first hour is used to import your history.

error.invalid_token: That does not look like an access token.
error.token_expired: The token has expired. Log in again and copy a new one.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Novafos/KMD API.
error.no_meters: No active water or heating meters were found on this login.

abort.already_configured: This Novafos customer is already set up.

init.title: Options
init.description: Paste a new access token to fetch new data (valid for one hour), and/or set your water price per m³ for {year} incl. VAT (water + wastewater). The price feeds the "Novafos Water cost" statistic for the Energy dashboard. Leave the token empty to only change the price.

access_token.description: The access_token from the Novafos login. 'Bearer ' prefix or the whole JSON response is also accepted.
